definitions.name: CPI-U, all items, U.S. city average
definitions.population: All urban consumers; excludes rural nonmetropolitan residents, farm households, military installations, religious communities and institutions as defined by BLS.
definitions.adjustment: not seasonally adjusted
definitions.period_convention: Calendar month YYYY-MM
definitions.cadence: Monthly; normally released the following month at 08:30 America/New_York. Consult the official schedule for changes.
definitions.boundary: National urban target in the 50 states and DC, excluding territories. No state, county, metro or DC-only output.
definitions.sample_design: 2018 geographic redesign, 2010 Census population / 2013 OMB CBSAs; not an expenditure-weight vintage.
definitions.uncertainty_note: Survey-derived index; confidence intervals are not supplied in this extract. Unknown is not zero uncertainty.
definitions.revision_policy: NSA CPI-U has no routine seasonal revision; corrections remain possible. Latest publisher values only, not a vintage archive.
definitions.licence: US public domain; cite US Bureau of Labor Statistics
